pagination: Cursor-based via RFC5988 Link header rel=next; follow until absent. max sets page size.

endpoints.name: get_me
endpoints.purpose: Auth verification / identify token owner and org.

endpoints.name: list_rooms
endpoints.purpose: Enumerate spaces/rooms; each indexed as a document and used as message container.

endpoints.name: list_messages
endpoints.purpose: List messages within a room (roomId required); each indexed as a document.

endpoints.name: list_memberships
endpoints.purpose: List room members (roomId required) to build per-space allowed_users permissions.

endpoints.name: list_events
endpoints.purpose: Org-wide compliance stream (resource=messages); embeds full message in data. Requires Compliance Officer + spark-compliance scopes. ~90-day lookback.

endpoints.name: get_room
endpoints.purpose: Fetch a single room's metadata by id (org-wide path resolves room title for arbitrary rooms).

scopes.note: Compliance scope strings should be confirmed on developer.webex.com; org-wide reads verified live against the org with a Compliance-Officer-capable token.
